rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a jar or similar container.

example.english: There’s a jar of jam in the kitchen.
example.jyutping: cyu4 fong2 jau5 jat1 zeon1 gwo2 zoeng3

rows.note: Use this for the shaking or jolting movement or sensation itself.

example.english: The glass jar is vibrating on top of the washing machine.
example.traditional: 個玻璃樽喺洗衣機上面震動緊。
example.jyutping: go3 bo1 lei4 zeon1 hai2 sai2 ji1 gei1 soeng6 min6 zan3 dung6 gan2

rows.note: Use this when the jar means a clash or contradictory effect between things.

example.english: These two colors jar when put together.
example.traditional: 呢兩種顏色擺埋一齊好衝突。
example.jyutping: ni1 loeng5 zung2 ngaan4 sik1 baai2 maai4 jat1 cai4 hou2 cung1 dat6

rows.note: Use this specifically for a pint serving of beer or cider.

example.english: They served me a pint of beer in a jar.
example.traditional: 佢哋用樽裝一品脫啤酒畀我。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 jung6 zeon1 zong1 jat1 ban2 tyut3 be1 zau2 bei2 ngo5
